decisions.reason: After an initial learning period, the product’s absence from visible market communication in 2020–2021 suggests results likely remained below aspiration for a relatively component-like offer, so we would reallocate resources to stronger core exchanger lines and new development.

Even though enhanced tubes fit our R&D trajectory, two years without visible market presence indicate weak standalone traction relative to aspirations, so boundedly rational management would end the market offer and redirect the resources to higher-potential portfolio uses.
